true_positive_escalated.description: Security event evaluated and confirmed as an incident requiring response.

false_positive_confirmed.description: Security event evaluated and determined not to represent malicious activity.

benign_expected_behavior.description: Security event matches known/allowed system or user behavior.

duplicate_of_existing_incident.description: Security event is a duplicate detection of an already-tracked incident.

insufficient_evidence_closed_monitoring.description: Security event could not be conclusively evaluated; closed with continued monitoring in place.
